lede: The heaviest lift this week lands in San Miguel County, where the Planning Commission takes up proposed amendments to the Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation Fee structure on November 12 — a conversation that shapes whether workforce housing actually gets built here. Ouray County's BOCC also has a full plate Monday, with two public hearings including the Curry Regular PUD land split and a budget amendment, plus a vote on repealing an austerity resolution. On the lighter side, the KOTO Ski Swap kicks off Friday and the Ridgway Independent Film Festival runs through the weekend.
